top_signals.title: Texas Allows Wider Use of Dyed Diesel as War Boosts Fuel Costs
top_signals.summary: Texas is allowing wider use of so-called dyed diesel that’s normally limited to off-road vehicles, as a global fuel crunch boosts prices and prompts President Donald Trump to consider banning US exports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: EU support to research and innovation increases with additional €500 million for research programme Horizon Europe
